s1d1: "Paintballer paints tiles and Clouds around them. Painted Clouds bounce lower, they also inflict Painted for 5 seconds."
s2d1: - Paintballer gains an aura that paints any tile or cloud inside of it. Clouds that are painted have a weakened boost, and applies the same slowness effect from painted tiles.
s2d2: - Dripping Paint will appear in curse selections after level 5.
